description: This file defines a React component for the Settings page of a to-do list application, including subcomponents for different settings sections. It provides a UI for user preferences, profile info, notifications, and theme selection.

methods.name: SettingsPage()
methods.description: Main functional component rendering the settings page with tabs and respective sections.

methods.name: ProfileSection()
methods.description: Component rendering user profile input fields like name, email, timezone, and date format.

methods.name: PreferencesSection()
methods.description: Component rendering user preferences such as default view, smart schedule, auto-archive, and start week day.

methods.name: NotificationsSection()
methods.description: Component providing email and push notification options.

methods.name: ThemeSection()
methods.description: Component for selecting the theme (Light, Dark, Auto).
